related_bodies.name: RTR KI-Servicestelle
related_bodies.role: The data protection authority's FAQ says that, in preparation for implementing the AI Act, an AI service desk set up in RTR serves as a contact point and information hub on AI.

related_bodies.name: Datenschutzbehörde
related_bodies.designation_note: The data protection authority's guidance says that Article 74(8) of the AI Act gives the supervisory authorities for data protection the market-surveillance role for high-risk AI in areas such as law enforcement, border management, justice and democracy, and that under current law this competence falls to it under sections 18 and 31 of the Data Protection Act.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and German, with the Federal Chancellery's government news listing for November (newest 9 November). No qualifying national institute or new national AI Act designation was found. Left for review: Austria's proposal of 28 October to host a UN AI cooperation centre in Vienna, whose possible model-evaluation expertise is conditional and international, and Austria's place on the endorsement list of the French presidency's Paris Call for AI Safety and Security, published on 9 November and since updated. The annual listing page showed navigation only and no item dates. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded de query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: AT-search = searches 1, 2 (en, de). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The DSB FAQ explains its sectoral AI Act supervisory competence. Its undated statement on unresolved general designation is not treated as a dated absence finding.
